meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 用大白话把某个技术概念拆成五个方面讲:谁(涉及的人)、是什么、在哪里、为什么、什么时候。
howto.when: 当你说想用大白话了解某个技术概念,或提到 who、what、where、why、when 这类说法时触发。

say.text: 用大白话讲讲什么是API,按谁、什么、哪里、为什么、何时来讲。
say.note: Claude会按这五个方面逐条解释。

say.text: 给我通俗解释一下区块链的who、what、where、why、when。
say.note: 它会围绕这五个角度组织回答。

howto.what_en: Explains a technical topic in plain English, broken down into five angles: who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a plain-English explanation of something technical, or mention the who/what/where/why/when framing.

say_en.text: Explain what an API is in plain English, covering who, what, where, why, and when.
say_en.note: Claude will answer point by point along these five angles.

say_en.text: Give me a simple breakdown of blockchain's who, what, where, why, and when.
say_en.note: It will organize the answer around those five angles.
